# Final goal verification

Read:

* `.ai/current-goal.md`
* `.ai/progress.md`

Review the implementation of the current goal.

Verify:

* acceptance criteria
* architecture consistency
* edge cases
* test coverage
* lint
* type checks
* build
* documentation

If everything passes:

* mark the goal DONE
* update `.ai/goals.md`
* prepare `.ai/current-goal.md` for the next goal

If anything is missing:

* create the smallest possible follow-up implementation step
* do not mark the goal complete.
